text:
Emma Chen: FYI — OrionCloud flagged a SKU mapping mismatch between their marketplace listing and our reserved capacity. They think they've reserved 8xA100-equivalents for the joint pilot, but the marketplace SKUs map to a family we don't actually hold in that reservation window. Can we pause the joint announcement until we confirm?

Raj Patel: Ugh. Do we have the raw mapping from Orion?

Emma Chen: They just DM'd a CSV. Pasting the problematic lines below for quick eyeballing:

orion_sku,marketplace_id,redwood_reserved_type
OC-GPU-8192,MP-oc-a100x8,A100-8x-resv
OC-GPU-8192,MP-oc-a100x8,A40-4x-resv <-- this is the mismatch

Lia Gomez: That second line is the issue — marketplace id MP-oc-a100x8 is pointing at a 4xA40 reservation in our system for that account. Might be a catalog sync bug on their side. How many customers are in the pilot?

Emma Chen: Two enterprise pilots (FinServCo, RetailX). Expected start next week if we don't delay.

Marcus Liu: If we publish the announcement and then they only get 4x A40 perf instead of 8x A100, we'll have an SLA/expectations problem. Ops can try to carve alternative capacity (different region or partner pool) but lead time to shift reserved capacity is 72–96 hours with current vendors.

Raj Patel: I pinged our Orion contact (cc'd via orioncloud-bot) to confirm source of the mapping. @Nina Torres — can legal OK a short delay message for customers? We want something that doesn't sound like we're backing out, just "final validation".

orioncloud-bot: OrionCloud engineering confirms: marketplace_id MP-oc-a100x8 was recently repurposed during SKU consolidation. They will revert mapping within 6 hours and confirm true hardware mapping.

Lia Gomez: Good. Action items: (1) I'll block the reserve reconciliation window and attempt a temporary region swap if Orion can't revert in time. (2) Marcus, can you estimate cost delta for shifting two pilot customers to the west-2 pool for 2 weeks?

Marcus Liu: Estimated delta ~ +18% token cost due to higher spot rates in west-2 and cross-zone egress for model artifacts. If we need guaranteed perf, reserved commit swap could push to +30% and needs procurement sign-off.

Nina Torres: Legal ok to delay announcement by up to 5 business days with a "final validation" phrasing, as long as we don't include specific hardware promises in external copy. I'll draft a one-paragraph hold message.

Emma Chen: Perfect. Raj — can you tell PM/Comms to gate the press release and update the launch calendar? Lia/Marcus — please post reconciliation ETA in this thread once you have it so I can update the partner.

Raj Patel: On it. I'll update the launch doc and tag comms. Putting a soft hold on public timelines. :handshake:

Lia Gomez: Orion just messaged: mapping revert complete, marketplace now maps MP-oc-a100x8 -> A100-8x-resv. They attached a reconciliation manifest. I'm pulling it into our inventory check now.

Marcus Liu: Inventory check green for FinServCo, RetailX — we can fulfill with minimal region swaps, no procurement needed. Cost delta within margin.

Emma Chen: Awesome. Reopening announcement after comms approves copy. Closing the loop with Orion and legal. Thanks team. :tada:
